declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.pivotRun
declarations.header: def pivotRun (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) : Measured α Nat

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.pivotRun_exact
declarations.header:
theorem pivotRun_exact (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    pivotRun xs i = (xs[i.val]'i.isLt, i.val + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun
declarations.header:
def stepRun (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    Measured ((Nat × List α) ⊕ α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_eq
declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_eq (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    let p

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_child
declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_child (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length)
    (j : Nat) (ys : List α) (h : (stepRun k xs i).1 = Sum.inl (j, ys)) :
    ys.length < xs.length ∧ (k < xs.length → j < ys.length)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.equal_lookup
declarations.header:
private theorem equal_lookup (p : α) (xs : List α) (k : Nat)
    (hl : (partition3 p xs).1.length ≤ k)
    (he : k < (partition3 p xs).1.length + (partition3 p xs).2.1.length) :
    (partition3 p xs).2.1[k - (partition3 p xs).1.length]? = some p

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_semantics
declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_semantics (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    (match (stepRun k xs i).1 with
      | Sum.inl (j, ys) => (ordered ys)[j]?
      | Sum.inr p => some p) = (ordered xs)[k]?

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_ranked
declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_ranked (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) (a : α)
    (h : (stepRun k xs i).1 = Sum.inr a) : RankedAt xs k a

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_cost_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_cost_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    xs.length ≤ (stepRun k xs i).2 ∧ (stepRun k xs i).2 ≤ 9 * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.pivotLaw
declarations.header: def pivotLaw (head : α) (tail : List α) : PMF α

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.pivotLaw_support
declarations.header:
theorem pivotLaw_support (head : α) (tail : List α) (a : α)
    (h : a ∈ (pivotLaw head tail).support) : a ∈ head :: tail

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.pivotLaw_event
declarations.header:
theorem pivotLaw_event (head : α) (tail : List α) (event : α → Bool) :
    PMF.map event (pivotLaw head tail) true =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (tail.length + 1) =>
        event ((head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt) = true)).card : ℝ≥0∞) /
          ((tail.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.singleton_step
declarations.header:
theorem singleton_step :
    stepRun 0 [7] ⟨0, by decide⟩ = (Sum.inr 7, 9)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.duplicate_middle
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_middle :
    stepRun 1 [0, 0, 1] ⟨1, by decide⟩ = (Sum.inr 0, 15)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.selected_side_is_not_larger_side
declarations.header:
theorem selected_side_is_not_larger_side :
    (stepRun 0 [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] ⟨1, by decide⟩).1 =
      Sum.inl (0, [0]) ∧ max 1 3 = 3

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.selected_side_valid
declarations.header:
theorem selected_side_valid :
    ([0] : List Nat).length < ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4] : List Nat).length ∧
      (0 < ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4] : List Nat).length → 0 < ([0] : List Nat).length)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.duplicate_ranked
declarations.header: theorem duplicate_ranked : RankedAt ([0, 0, 1] : List Nat) 1 0

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.duplicate_source_bound
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_source_bound :
    3 ≤ (stepRun 1 [0, 0, 1] ⟨1, by decide⟩).2 ∧
      (stepRun 1 [0, 0, 1] ⟨1, by decide⟩).2 ≤ 27

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.duplicate_zero_probability
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_zero_probability :
    PMF.map (fun a : Nat => decide (a = 0)) (pivotLaw 0 [0, 1]) true =
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) / 3

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelection.duplicate_one_probability
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_one_probability :
    PMF.map (fun a : Nat => decide (a = 1)) (pivotLaw 0 [0, 1]) true =
      (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / 3

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanVolume_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem scanVolume_nil : scanVolume [] = 0

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanVolume_cons
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem scanVolume_cons (n i : Nat) (trace : Trace) :

declarations.header: def prepend (n i calls : Nat) (result : Outcome α) : Outcome α

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run
declarations.header:
def run : Nat → List α → PMF (Outcome α)
  | _, [] => PMF.pure (none, ([], (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun ([] : List α)).2 + 1))
  | k, head :: tail =>
      PMF.bind (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let action

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_nil
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem run_nil (k : Nat) :
    run k ([] : List α) = PMF.pure (none, ([], 2))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_cons
declarations.header:
theorem run_cons (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    run k (head :: tail) =
      PMF.bind (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let action

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_value
declarations.header:
theorem run_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.1 = (ordered xs)[k]?

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_ranked
declarations.header:
theorem run_ranked (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) (a : α) (ha : result.1 = some a) :
    RankedAt xs k a

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_none
declarations.header:
theorem run_none (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.1 = none ↔ xs.length ≤ k

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_valid
declarations.header:
theorem run_valid (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length)
    (result : Outcome α) (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∃ a, result.1 = some a ∧ RankedAt xs k a

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_support_bounds
declarations.header:
private theorem run_support_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    result.2.1.length ≤ xs.length ∧
      xs.length ≤ scanVolume result.2.1 ∧
      2 * scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ xs.length * (xs.length + 1) ∧
      scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ result.2.2 ∧
      result.2.2 ≤ 9 * scanVolume result.2.1 + 2 ∧
      ∀ entry ∈ result.2.1, 0 < entry.1 ∧ entry.2 < entry.1 ∧ entry.1 ≤ xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_active_calls_le
declarations.header:
theorem run_active_calls_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.2.1.length ≤ xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_initial_scan_le
declarations.header:
theorem run_initial_scan_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : xs.length ≤ scanVolume result.2.1

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_scanVolume_le
declarations.header:
theorem run_scanVolume_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_source_bridge
declarations.header:
theorem run_source_bridge (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ result.2.2 ∧ result.2.2 ≤ 9 * scanVolume result.2.1 + 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_trace_entries
declarations.header:
theorem run_trace_entries (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∀ entry ∈ result.2.1, 0 < entry.1 ∧ entry.2 < entry.1 ∧ entry.1 ≤ xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_source_quadratic
declarations.header:
theorem run_source_quadratic (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    result.2.2 ≤ 9 * (xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2) + 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.select
declarations.header: def select (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : PMF (Outcome α)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.select_value
declarations.header:
theorem select_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) : result.1 = sortSelect k xs

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.select_none
declarations.header:
theorem select_none (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) :
    result.1 = none ↔ k = 0 ∨ xs.length < k

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.select_some_iff
declarations.header:
theorem select_some_iff (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) (a : α) :
    result.1 = some a ↔ 0 < k ∧ RankedAt xs (k - 1) a

theorem scanLaw_support (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanLaw_support_finite
declarations.header: theorem scanLaw_support_finite (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : (scanLaw k xs).support.Finite

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceLaw_support

theorem sourceLaw_support (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.header: theorem sourceLaw_support_finite (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : (sourceLaw k xs).support.Finite

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.empty_failure
declarations.header:
theorem empty_failure (k : Nat) :
    run k ([] : List α) = PMF.pure (none, ([], 2))

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.singleton_execution
declarations.header:
theorem singleton_execution (x : α) :
    run 0 [x] = PMF.pure (some x, ([(1, 0)], 9))

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.invalid_singleton
declarations.header:
theorem invalid_singleton :
    run 1 ([7] : List Nat) = PMF.pure (none, ([(1, 0)], 11))

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.rank_zero_public_failure
declarations.header:
theorem rank_zero_public_failure (xs : List α) :
    select 0 xs = PMF.pure (none, ([], 0))

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.two_key_execution
Examples.RandomSelectionRun.duplicate_execution
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_execution (x : α) :
    run 1 [x, x] =
      PMF.map (fun i : Fin 2 => (some x, ([(2, i.val)], 12 + i.val)))
        (Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.two_key_first_path
declarations.header:
theorem two_key_first_path :
    ((some 0, ([(2, 0)], 11)) : Outcome Nat) ∈ (run 0 [0, 1]).support

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.two_key_long_path
declarations.header:
theorem two_key_long_path :

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.same_value_different_scan
declarations.header:
theorem same_value_different_scan :
    ((some 0, ([(2, 0)], 11)) : Outcome Nat).1 =
      ((some 0, ([(2, 1), (1, 0)], 20)) : Outcome Nat).1 ∧
    scanVolume [(2, 0)] ≠ scanVolume [(2, 1), (1, 0)]

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.maximum_scan_on_pair
declarations.header:
theorem maximum_scan_on_pair :
    scanVolume [(2, 1), (1, 0)] = 3 ∧
      scanVolume [(2, 1), (1, 0)] ≤ (2 * (2 + 1)) / 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.bounded_actual_pair_calls
declarations.header:
theorem bounded_actual_pair_calls :
    scanVolume [(2, 1), (1, 0)] ≤ 20 ∧
      20 ≤ 9 * scanVolume [(2, 1), (1, 0)] + 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionRun.arbitrary_supported_rank
declarations.header:
theorem arbitrary_supported_rank (xs : List α) (k : Nat) (result : Outcome α)
    (h : result ∈ (select k xs).support) (a : α) :
    result.1 = some a ↔ 0 < k ∧ RankedAt xs (k - 1) a

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.weighted_bind
declarations.header:
private theorem weighted_bind (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (g : β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' b, p.bind f b * g b) = ∑' a, p a * (∑' b, f a b * g b)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.weighted_pure
declarations.header:
private theorem weighted_pure (x : α) (g : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' a, PMF.pure x a * g a) = g x

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.weighted_map
declarations.header:
private theorem weighted_map (p : PMF α) (f : α → β) (g : β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' b, p.map f b * g b) = ∑' a, p a * g (f a)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.weighted_add
declarations.header:
private theorem weighted_add (p : PMF α) (f g : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' a, p a * (f a + g a)) = (∑' a, p a * f a) + ∑' a, p a * g a

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.weighted_const
declarations.header:
private theorem weighted_const (p : PMF α) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' a, p a * c) = c

Resources.RandomSelection.lintegral_nat_eq
declarations.header:
private theorem lintegral_nat_eq (p : PMF Nat) :
    (∫⁻ k : Nat, (k : ℝ≥0∞) ∂p.toMeasure) = ∑' k, p k * (k : ℝ≥0∞)

Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation
declarations.header: def workExpectation (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (f : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_mono
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_mono (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (f g : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞)
    (h : ∀ result ∈ (run k xs).support, f result ≤ g result) :
    workExpectation k xs f ≤ workExpectation k xs g

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_const
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_const (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    workExpectation k xs (fun _ => c) = c

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_add
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_add (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (f g : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    workExpectation k xs (fun result => f result + g result) =
      workExpectation k xs f + workExpectation k xs g

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_mul
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_mul (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (c : ℝ≥0∞)
    (f : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    workExpectation k xs (fun result => c * f result) = c * workExpectation k xs f

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_nil
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_nil (k : Nat) (f : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    workExpectation k [] f = f (none, ([], 2))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.workExpectation_cons
declarations.header:
theorem workExpectation_cons (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α)
    (f : Outcome α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    workExpectation k (head :: tail) f =
      ∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1),
        let action

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_eq_workExpectation
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_eq_workExpectation (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    scanExpectation k xs =
      workExpectation k xs (fun result => (scanVolume result.2.1 : ℝ≥0∞))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_eq_workExpectation
declarations.header:
theorem sourceExpectation_eq_workExpectation (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    sourceExpectation k xs =
      workExpectation k xs (fun result => (result.2.2 : ℝ≥0∞))

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_quadratic_le
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_quadratic_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    scanExpectation k xs ≤ ((xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_quadratic_le
declarations.header:
theorem sourceExpectation_quadratic_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    sourceExpectation k xs ≤
      ((9 * (xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2) + 2 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞)

declarations.header: theorem scanExpectation_ne_top (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : scanExpectation k xs ≠ ∞

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_ne_top
declarations.header: theorem sourceExpectation_ne_top (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : sourceExpectation k xs ≠ ∞

declarations.header:
theorem scanLaw_integrable (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceLaw_integrable
declarations.header:
theorem sourceLaw_integrable (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_initial_le
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_initial_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_comparison
declarations.header:
theorem sourceExpectation_comparison (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    scanExpectation k xs ≤ sourceExpectation k xs ∧
      sourceExpectation k xs ≤ 9 * scanExpectation k xs + 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem scanExpectation_nil (k : Nat) : scanExpectation k ([] : List α) = 0

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem sourceExpectation_nil (k : Nat) : sourceExpectation k ([] : List α) = 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_cons
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_cons (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    scanExpectation k (head :: tail) =
      ((tail.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞) +
        (((tail.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) *
          ∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1),
            match (stepRun k (head :: tail) i).1 with
            | Sum.inl (j, ys) => scanExpectation j ys
            | Sum.inr _ => 0

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceMean_quadratic_le

theorem sourceMean_quadratic_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

theorem two_key_scan_law :

        (Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.two_key_source_law
declarations.header:
theorem two_key_source_law :

        (Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.two_key_scan_mean
declarations.header: theorem two_key_scan_mean : scanMean 0 ([0, 1] : List Nat) = (5 : ℝ) / 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.two_key_source_mean
declarations.header: theorem two_key_source_mean : sourceMean 0 ([0, 1] : List Nat) = (31 : ℝ) / 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.duplicate_scan_law
declarations.header: theorem duplicate_scan_law (x : α) : scanLaw 1 [x, x] = PMF.pure 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.duplicate_source_law
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_source_law (x : α) :
    sourceLaw 1 [x, x] = PMF.map (fun i : Fin 2 => 12 + i.val)
      (Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.duplicate_means
declarations.header:
theorem duplicate_means (x : α) :
    scanMean 1 [x, x] = 2 ∧ sourceMean 1 [x, x] = (25 : ℝ) / 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.two_key_scan_step
declarations.header:
theorem two_key_scan_step :
    scanExpectation 0 ([0, 1] : List Nat) =
      2 + (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * scanExpectation 0 ([0] : List Nat)

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.arbitrary_input_integrable
declarations.header:
theorem arbitrary_input_integrable (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    Integrable (fun w : Nat => (w : ℝ)) (scanLaw k xs).toMeasure ∧
      Integrable (fun t : Nat => (t : ℝ)) (sourceLaw k xs).toMeasure

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.actual_mean_bridge
declarations.header:
theorem actual_mean_bridge (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    scanMean k xs ≤ sourceMean k xs ∧ sourceMean k xs ≤ 9 * scanMean k xs + 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionMean.selected_value_and_mean_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem selected_value_and_mean_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length)
    (result : Outcome α) (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∃ a, result.1 = some a ∧ Applications.Selection.RankedAt xs k a ∧
      (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ scanMean k xs ∧ scanMean k xs ≤ sourceMean k xs

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum
declarations.header: def rankSideSum (n : Nat) : Nat

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_zero
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem rankSideSum_zero : rankSideSum 0 = 0

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_one
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem rankSideSum_one : rankSideSum 1 = 0

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_add_two
declarations.header:
theorem rankSideSum_add_two (n : Nat) :
    rankSideSum (n + 2) = rankSideSum n + 3 * n + 2

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_bound
declarations.header: theorem rankSideSum_bound (n : Nat) : 4 * rankSideSum n ≤ 3 * n * n

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.four_mul_three_quarters
declarations.header: private theorem four_mul_three_quarters : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) * (3 / 4) = 3

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.rankSideSum_mean_le
declarations.header:
theorem rankSideSum_mean_le (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (rankSideSum n : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) * n

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_lt_of_lt
declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_lt_of_lt (xs : List α) (i j : Fin xs.length)
    (hij : xs[i.val] < xs[j.val]) :
    RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i < RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs j

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_tie
declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_tie (xs : List α) (i j : Fin xs.length)
    (hij : i < j) (hvalue : xs[i.val] = xs[j.val]) :
    RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i < RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs j

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.occurrenceRank_uniform
declarations.header:
theorem occurrenceRank_uniform (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    PMF.map (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id (head :: tail))
      (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length) =
        RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.filter_length_eq_card_indices
Resources.RandomSelection.strict_side_rank_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem strict_side_rank_bounds (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    (partition3 (xs[i.val]'i.isLt) xs).1.length ≤
        (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val ∧
      (partition3 (xs[i.val]'i.isLt) xs).2.2.length ≤
        xs.length - 1 - (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize
declarations.header: def nextSize (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) : Nat

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_le_rankSide
declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_le_rankSide (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    nextSize k xs i ≤
      max (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val
        (xs.length - 1 - (RandomQuickSort.occurrenceRank id xs i).val)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_sum_le
declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_sum_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (∑ i : Fin xs.length, nextSize k xs i) ≤ rankSideSum xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.nextSize_drift
declarations.header:
theorem nextSize_drift (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    (∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1),
      RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length i *
        (nextSize k (head :: tail) i : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤
          (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) * (tail.length + 1 : Nat)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_linear_le
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_linear_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    scanExpectation k xs ≤ 4 * (xs.length : ℝ≥0∞)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanExpectation_linear_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem scanExpectation_linear_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.length : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ scanExpectation k xs ∧
      scanExpectation k xs ≤ 4 * (xs.length : ℝ≥0∞)

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanMean_linear_le
declarations.header:

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.scanMean_linear_bounds
declarations.header:

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceExpectation_linear_bounds

declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.sourceMean_linear_bounds

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.stable_duplicate_positions

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.refined_duplicate_uniform

        Resources.RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex 1

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.singleton_next_size

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.duplicate_next_expectation
declarations.header:

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.duplicate_drift_bound

      (nextSize 2 ([0, 0, 1] : List Nat) i : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ (9 : ℝ≥0∞) / 4

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.selected_branch_is_smaller
declarations.header:
theorem selected_branch_is_smaller :
    nextSize 0 ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4] : List Nat) ⟨1, by decide⟩ = 1 ∧ max 1 3 = 3

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.arbitrary_expected_bounds
declarations.header:

      (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ sourceMean k xs ∧ sourceMean k xs ≤ 36 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.valid_selection_expected_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem valid_selection_expected_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length)

      (xs.length : ℝ) ≤ scanMean k xs ∧ scanMean k xs ≤ 4 * (xs.length : ℝ) ∧
        sourceMean k xs ≤ 36 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 2

declarations.name: Examples.RandomSelectionDrift.empty_expected_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem empty_expected_bounds (k : Nat) :
    scanMean k ([] : List α) = 0 ∧ sourceMean k ([] : List α) = 2 ∧
      scanMean k ([] : List α) ≤ 0 ∧ sourceMean k ([] : List α) ≤ 2
